Profile the raw file

Read the original values as strings when you want to see how source codes are represented. Inspect shape and column names first, then count blanks and unexpected labels in the columns you need.

import pandas as pd

raw = pd.read_csv("store_sales.csv", dtype="string", keep_default_na=False)
print(raw.shape)
print(raw.duplicated().sum())
print(raw["Location"].str.strip().eq("").sum())

Check patterns, not just null counts

Confirm ID uniqueness against the row grain. Validate date range, allowed categories, and numeric rules. Inspect candidate outliers before deciding they are errors or legitimate observations.
